cards.examples: screens, beacons, diamonds, scans, art pieces
cards.behavior: stay pinned, reflect sound, have hardness score

particles.examples: sound waves, dust, lubricant, granules, pheromones, gases
particles.behavior: drift, bounce off cards, scatter, refine, dissolve

cards_vs_particles.interaction: Particles bounce off cards. Cards redirect particles. The SCATTER pattern reveals the topology.

particle_types.name: sound_wave
particle_types.behavior: emanates from source (Kevin), bounces off hard surfaces, decays with distance
particle_types.origin: Kevin at center — radiates outward directionally, NOT as round cycle

particle_types.name: dust
particle_types.behavior: drifts slowly, settles on surfaces, stirred by movement
particle_types.origin: shed from all objects — keyboards, skin, screens

particle_types.name: lubricant
particle_types.behavior: reduces friction between cards, helps them slide past each other during sort
particle_types.origin: generated during sort operations — the oil that makes sorting smooth

particle_types.name: pheromone
particle_types.behavior: diffuses outward, crosses membranes, signals to other Gaias

particle_types.name: neutrino_stream
particle_types.behavior: passes through EVERYTHING — barely interacts, flavor oscillates
particle_types.physics: straight line, no bounce, no stop — detection by flavor only

particle_types.name: photon
particle_types.behavior: reflects off screens (gold/hard), absorbed by dark (#010409)
particle_types.origin: screens emit, sun emits, all light sources
particle_types.physics: speed of light, reflection angle = incidence angle

particle_types.name: refinement
particle_types.behavior: particles that survived sorting — the purest extract
particle_types.origin: output of digestive tract — what Gaia kept after eating

sound_source_tracking.description: Sound emanates FROM Kevin, not as a round cycle. Gaia traces the origin by backtracking wavefronts.
steps: 3. Cross-correlation finds delay between direct and reflected
6. Backtrack wavefronts to find Kevin (the source)
7. Scatter trace outward to map all hard surfaces
8. Build sonar model of the room
